text:
oncall-maya: Heads up — apiserver 5xx spike in eu-west1, started ~3m ago. controller-manager leader flips and GPU onboarding stuck. ~30% 5xx on /api/v1/watch. Anyone seeing DNS or NAT churn? @infra_ana @sre_jamie
infra_ana: seeing high conntrack on a few nodes being attached, kube-proxy logs show NAT table churn and a lot of TCP CLOSE_WAITs
sre_jamie: apiserver logs show repeated EOF handshakes and watch reconnect storms: 
```
server.go:2190: http2: panic serving 10.1.5.3: read tcp 10.1.0.2:6443->10.1.5.3:52344: EOF
controller-manager: leader election renew failed: timed out
```
oncall-maya: also GPU provisioner in PendingAttach with exponential retries, attach-controller spamming cloud API
eng-ops-chris: could be stale DNS endpoints for kube-dns causing clients to hit dead IPs -> connect timeouts -> watch reconnect fanout -> apiserver fds blow up
deploy-bot: deployment "kube-dns-config" rolled at 6187654300 (config change: ttl from 30s -> 10s)
infra_ana: ah that TTL change was rolled only in eu-west1 earlier, maybe half the nodes saw new TTL, half old -> endpoint churn. Checking endpoints...
infra_ana: `kubectl get endpoints coredns -n kube-system -o jsonpath='{.subsets[*].addresses[*].ip}'` returns mix of old IPs and some unreachable ones
oncall-maya: plan? do we rollback or restart DNS? we need to stem 5xxs and stop GPU attach storms (costs mounting)
sre_jamie: short-term: reduce apiserver watch fanout by throttling provisioning controllers. Can we temporarily pause the GPU onboarding controller?
eng-ops-chris: can patch provisioner to `syncPeriod: 2m` and add a backoff cap. I'll apply a kill -9 to the active rollout? better: scale controller replicas to 0 in eu-west1 for 5 min while we stabilize
infra_ana: I'll roll restart coredns DaemonSet in eu-west1 only: `kubectl rollout restart ds/coredns -n kube-system --grace-period=0` and remove stale endpoints after restart
cost-signal-sasha: FYI attach retries are spiking API calls — rough estimate +25% attach calls for the region, ~ $3k/hr on cloud attach API (temporary)
oncall-maya: doing the restart now (eu-west1-only). Creating incident page and will post updates in 15m
sre_jamie: also increased apiserver `--max-requests-inflight` temporarily and bumped file descriptors on control-plane proxies to buy time
infra_ana: coredns restart done, endpoints reconciled, conntrack counts falling on affected nodes
eng-ops-chris: applied provisioner scale-down in eu-west1 (replicas=0) and added a 30s jitter to onboarding to avoid thundering herd
sre_jamie: apiserver 5xx reduced from 30% -> 2% over the last 3 mins, leader election stable, controller-manager renews succeeding
oncall-maya: GPU provisioner starting to attach again with backoff; pending attach queue draining
cost-signal-sasha: monitoring cost delta, dropping back towards baseline — keeping an eye on attach RPCs
oncall-maya: will follow up with RCA and recommend we gate TTL changes behind a canary and a rollout script for DNS endpoint drain. Opening an ops doc ticket.
sre_jamie: thumbs on docs: record mitigation steps + exact commands used. Add rollback step for ttl change. :thumbsup:
infra_ana: I pushed a short postmortem draft to the incident doc, will tag you all for review
oncall-maya: thanks all — closing thread after doc posted
